Class PointTests

java.lang.Object
primitives.PointTests
class PointTests extends Object
Unit tests for class Point. The tests verify:
  • Point constructor validity
  • Point operations: subtract, add, distance
  • Point properties: equals, toString
Tests follow the methodology of Equivalence Partitions (EP) and Boundary Values (BVA).
